evidence_notes: The August2026 joint UDMI recommends mechanism-based classification, including early recurrence, rather than a separate recurrent code. This clinical update is respected; the user-selected WHO2026-01 denominator remains frozen and its existing BA42 leaves are evaluated as historical classification targets, not claimed to be the latest clinical nomenclature. No28-day home-treatment cutoff or troponin percentage is prescribed.

candidate_codes.rationale: The frozen2026-01 BA42 subtree comprises a subsequent infarction, with STEMI/NSTEMI or unspecified type. Existing fourteen sections apply to recurrent acute MI; the new first-month diagnostic branch explains residual abnormalities and reassessment rather than treating recurrent pain as confirmed infarction. Earlier BA41 mappings remain separate.
